categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Anlogic Infotech Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, and sales of FPGA and FPSoC chips along with dedicated EDA software. Their products serve diverse applications including communication, industrial, medical, audio-visual broadcasting, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, data centers, and testing and verification. The company also develops application IPs and reference designs to support various industry needs.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced FPGA and FPSoC chip architectures, including integration of ARM and RISC-V processors, high-performance IP cores, and advanced packaging technologies like Chiplet. They develop proprietary full-process FPGA EDA software (TangDynasty and FutureDynasty) incorporating AI algorithms to enhance design efficiency. Manufacturing follows a fabless model, outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to third-party foundries and subcontractors.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include industrial, communication, automotive, medical, data center, and consumer electronics sectors. The company serves over two thousand customers, including major industry leaders, with products applied in machine vision, smart manufacturing, smart healthcare, high-end displays, and automotive electronics. Sales are primarily domestic with growing international market penetration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and multiple branches in Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, Jinan, and Chengdu. It also has subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Sichuan. Overseas market expansion efforts are ongoing, supported by strategic partnerships and a global sales network.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Anlogic operates as a fabless semiconductor company, focusing on chip design and development (upstream/midstream). It outsources wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries and subcontractors downstream. The company maintains close collaboration with suppliers and partners to ensure supply chain stability and product quality.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high R&D investment, focusing on next-generation FPGA and FPSoC chip development, advanced packaging, and software ecosystem enhancement. It emphasizes expanding product portfolios with differentiated features, improving EDA software capabilities, and developing application IPs and reference designs. Strategic R&D also targets automotive-grade chips, AI integration, and emerging markets like edge computing and robotics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of FPGA and FPSoC chips and related technical services. The company also earns income from licensing technology, providing technical support, and selling dedicated EDA software. Sales channels include direct sales and distributor-based models, with a majority of revenue from domestic markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The FPGA industry is highly concentrated with global leaders like AMD (Xilinx) and Intel (Altera) dominating. Shanghai Anlogic is a leading domestic FPGA chip design company in China, actively expanding its market share and product offerings to compete internationally. It leverages strong R&D and localized supply chain advantages to differentiate itself in the competitive landscape.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 651.8 million, a 6.99% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 205.1 million. Despite revenue decline due to market inventory adjustments and demand variability, product shipment volume increased by 46.14%. R&D expenses remain high at 55.77% of revenue, reflecting ongoing investment in innovation. Total assets stood at RMB 1.39 billion with equity of RMB 1.22 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Anlogic emphasizes its deep technical expertise, comprehensive product matrix, and integrated one-stop service system combining FPGA/FPSoC chips, proprietary EDA software, IPs, and technical support. Its products offer high flexibility, low latency, and high integration, tailored for diverse and evolving application scenarios. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive IP portfolio, and customer-centric approach provide competitive differentiation and enable rapid adaptation to market needs.
